newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Show widening bias.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Show widening bias.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads showed a widening bias against its dollar bloc partners, extending Wednesday's blow-out following a set of inflation data that did not live up to the most optimistic expectations.
The local market was in a state of consolidation, particularly after Wednesday's wild swings, and ahead of Friday's local holiday, traders said.
The market was pretty much in line with the fall seen in U.S. Treasuries on Wednesday after a well bid five-year note sale lacked any follow-through in the secondary market.

Canadian bonds showed a mild outperformance against the U.S. on Wednesday, helped by a firmer Canadian dollar, while similarly the short-end of the New Zealand curve was supported by a rising N.Z. TWI.
Australian and New Zealand markets are closed on Friday for ANZAC Day.
